The Workouts Design Team at Peloton is focused on designing new software experiences that enable people to live both healthier and longer lives. The team works collaboratively with designers across the organization to create new workout experiences, novel software interactions for new hardware products, and intuitive ways of getting the best workout at-home, outdoors, or even in the gym.

Our Content Designers work strategically and cross-functionally to help craft flows for our members with intentional content that informs and helps our users make decisions to get maximum benefit from our fitness experiences. They approach problems with an agile mentality and rapidly iterate alongside cross-functional partners.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll partner closely with product designers, product managers, user researchers, engineers, product marketing, brand creative, and other cross-functional teams to bring features to life across our platforms.

Successful candidates are self-motivated, strategic, highly collaborative, proactive project owners, readily open to feedback and critique. They value the success of the team over their individual progress, and are often taking leadership over delivering outcomes.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, UXR/Analytics, and engineering to understand user needs and product goals

· Lead the creation and development of content strategies that influence the overall user experience

· Craft member-centric content for a variety of touchpoints across member journeys including UI, notifications, help documentation, etc.

· Partner with Brand and Product Marketing teams to develop and maintain a consistent tone of voice across our products

· Conduct content audits to ensure accuracy, relevance, quality, and adherence to the style guide

· Organize and maintain docs, decks and design files that can easily be tracked by cross-functional teams and partners

· Work closely with other Content Designers to develop and maintain content style guide, drive and advocate for best practices, and stay in the know of industry trends that could improve content strategies

· Help write content standards and contribute to our style guide

· Partner with legal, localization and support teams to ensure the content is accurately and responsibly launched

· 6+ years experience as a Content Designer or similar role (e.g. UX Writer, Content Strategist) in a software product environment

· You have a portfolio that showcases your craft and demonstrates how you think and solve problems

· A deep understanding of user experience and how content, design, research and more come together to build frictionless user flows

· Skills to set up frameworks and brainstorm initial design concepts

· The ability to present ideas, bring strategies to life, and incorporate feedback into your iterative work

· Experience working with AI, including dynamic and non-deterministic interfaces

· Comfortable working with ambiguous requirements and ability to quickly adapt and flex on direction of projects

· Excellent communication and organizational skills

· Cognitive awareness of wider business goals, delivering intuitive and user-centered design solutions

· Familiarity with the design systems, interaction patterns, and limitations of cross functional platforms - specifically Android, iOS, and web apps.

The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives and if the location for the job changes.

Our base salary is just one component of Peloton’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits.

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and wellbeing for our employees and their family. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:

· Medical, dental and vision insurance

· Generous paid time off policy

· Short-term and long-term disability

· Access to mental health services

· 401k, tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans

· Employee Stock Purchase Plan

· Fertility and adoption support and up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave

· Child care and family care discounts

· Free access to Peloton Digital App and apparel and product discounts

· Commuter benefits and Citi Bike Discount

· Pet insurance and so much more!

Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content.

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com.

Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law.

This policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all practices and procedures relating to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you would like to request any accommodations from application through to interview, please email: applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com .

At Peloton, we embrace technology, including AI, to enhance productivity and accelerate innovation in the work we do for our members. However, in our hiring process, our priority remains in getting to know you and your unique qualifications.

To ensure a fair and equitable process, we do not permit the use of AI tools during any stage of the application and interview process. In considering you as an applicant, we want to understand your skills, experiences, and motivations without mediation through an AI system.

We also want to directly assess your communication skills without the use of an AI tool.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, as applicable to applicants applying for positions in these jurisdictions.

Du siehst sofort, wenn ein Layout nicht funktioniert? Du hast Lust, eine Marke nicht nur zu pflegen, sondern sichtbar besser zu machen? Und du willst dich gestalterisch weiterentwickeln, statt nur abzuarbeiten?
Dann passt du wahrscheinlich richtig gut zu uns.
Wir bauen unser Marketing gerade neu auf und heben es auf ein professionelles Niveau. Genau dafür suchen wir dich: einen kreativen Kopf, der gestalterisch denkt und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Team eng mit einer Kollegin und mir zusammen, mit kurzen Wegen, direktem Austausch und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
Die GLOBAL-FINANZ ist einer der führenden Finanzdienstleister in Deutschland mit Sitz in Bonn. Für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden entwickeln wir Lösungen rund um Vermögensaufbau, Altersvorsorge und Immobilieninvestments.
Aufgaben
Dein Kern ist das Gestalten. Du machst aus unseren Materialien etwas, das nicht nach Standard aussieht, sondern professionell, modern und markengerecht ist. Dazu gehört zum Beispiel:
Layouts, Vorlagen und Designs für Broschüren, Flyer, One-Pager und Präsentationen
die Weiterentwicklung unseres Markenauftritts und unserer CI, von Farben über Typografie bis zu einem einheitlichen Icon- und Bildstil
Du wirst dabei nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen. Themen wie Farbmanagement musst du nicht von Tag eins beherrschen. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, dich da reinzuarbeiten und richtig gut darin zu werden.
Auch Fotografie gehört zur Rolle. Equipment ist vorhanden, du brauchst vor allem ein gutes Auge: für Berater-Porträts, Veranstaltungen oder Bilder von unserer Zentrale, die professionell wirken.
Und wir wollen sichtbarer werden. Social Media, vor allem Instagram und TikTok, wird Schritt für Schritt ein fester Teil deiner Rolle. Das heißt: Content mitdenken, Videos drehen und schneiden. Wenn dir das Spaß macht, bist du hier genau richtig.
Qualifikation
ein starkes Gespür für Design, Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwirkung
gute Kenntnisse in Tools wie InDesign, Photoshop und PowerPoint
ein gutes Auge für Details, Typografie und visuelle Qualität
Lust, Dinge nicht nur schön, sondern auch durchdacht umzusetzen
Offenheit für Fotografie, Video, Schnitt und Social-Media-Content
eine positive, neugierige Art und echte Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln
Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team eng zusammenzuarbeiten
Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist für uns zweitrangig. Wichtiger sind dein Können, dein Gespür und deine Arbeitsweise. Ob du dir deine Skills über eine Ausbildung, Berufserfahrung, freie Projekte oder privat aufgebaut hast, ist uns egal. Zeig uns einfach, was du kannst und worauf du stolz bist.
Warum die Rolle spannend ist
Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Abteilung, sondern in ein Umfeld, das gerade entsteht. Bisher haben wir vieles selbst gestaltet oder extern gelöst. Was uns fehlt, ist genau dein Blick: der eines Menschen, der Gestaltung wirklich kann und unseren Auftritt auf ein neues Level hebt. Du prägst, wie unsere Marke aussieht und wirkt, und hast dabei viel Verantwortung, viel Freiheit und echtes Entwicklungspotenzial.
Du musst noch nicht in jedem Bereich perfekt sein. Wichtig ist, dass du gestalterisch stark bist und Lust hast, mit uns zu wachsen.

Deine Ausstattung : ein neues MacBook, die volle Adobe Creative Cloud und moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, dazu professionelles Foto- und Videoequipment.
Flexibilität : Gleitzeit und mobiles Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche. Die übrige Zeit bist du bei uns in der Bonner Zentrale.
Team und Entwicklung : ein motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events sowie individuelle Weiterbildungen und Coachings, damit du dich fachlich weiterentwickelst.
Sicherheit und Vergütung : eine faire Vergütung, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Mitarbeiterbeteiligung und Bonuszahlungen.
Vorsorge und Gesundheit : eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge (unsere GLOBAL-FINANZ-Rente) mit Zuschüssen, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung für bessere medizinische Versorgung und Gesundheitsangebote wie Massagen.
Mobilität : gut erreichbar mit PKW und ÖPNV, dazu JobRad.
Extras : steuerfreie Sachbezüge über die GLOBAL-FINANZ-Firmenkarte und kostenfreie Getränke in der Zentrale.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gern eine Arbeitsprobe, ein Portfolio oder einen Link zu deiner Portfolio-Seite, damit wir einen Eindruck von deinem Stil bekommen. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben ist willkommen, aber kein Muss.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We’re looking for an experienced, San Francisco based Senior Content Designer who’s excited to work at the intersection of in-app wellbeing and health guidance, physiology and behavior science, and AI. An ideal candidate can write and prompt with heart and quality, is passionate about sustainable wellbeing, and sees AI not as a shortcut, but as a creative partner.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Oura communicates with its members around the world with clarity, empathy, and care.

As a Senior Content Designer at Oura, you’ll work across teams and disciplines to design in-app guidance that makes our health and wellbeing insights feel human, personal, and actionable. You’ll also help evolve how AI contributes to that experience by designing prompts, refining outputs, and ensuring Oura’s voice and values carry through every interaction.

You’ll collaborate closely with product design, product management, science and clinical, legal, regulatory, engineering, user research, and localization teams to create consistent, globally resonant in-app guidance mainly in our iOS and Android apps. You'll be both a content designer and a systems thinker, helping shape how language supports our members at scale, but meeting each member as they are, where they are.

You'll be joining a Content Design team spread across Finland, the UK, and the greater New York area. This is a hybrid role: we anticipate that you’ll come work with the team in our San Francisco office regularly, but also allow home office days.

· Create thoughtful, creative and concise English in-app guidance that helps our members understand and act on their health data, one example being the balance between activity and recovery.

· Co-create with AI , integrating it into your writing process in a way that’s purposeful and creative.

· Work together with our feature squads in content design all the way from feature discovery work to in-app copy implementation , driving relevant review and approval processes.

· Lead content design processes for your designated features, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure clarity and consistency in our guidance across touchpoints.

· Advocate for Oura’s signature health philosophy that’s rooted in the Nordics, and secure our epitome tone of voice across both human- and AI-generated content.

· 5+ years of proven hands-on content design / UX writing experience , preferably in the field of health and/or wellness communications.

· A strong understanding of tone, clarity, and emotional nuance in digital products , and the ability to work within established brand guidelines.

· Demonstrated experience using AI or LLMs as creative tools whether for prompting, prototyping, or scaling.

· Project management skills , capability to lead your own work streams, and experience in successful stakeholder communications.

· Curiosity and openness : you’re someone who learns fast, iterates often, and collaborates well across disciplines.

· Teamwork spirit and ability to collaborate in remote work environments. Due to time zones, this role is ideal for early morning types , and may not be healthy for night owls.

· A genuine passion for helping people live better, healthier lives through accessible technology and compassionate language.

· Background in health, behavioral science, or related domains.

· Experience in writing for multilingual or global audiences.

· Familiarity with UX research methods or user testing of content.
At Oura, we care deeply about your well-being and development. Every team member receives an Oura Ring, and we’re committed to supporting health, growth, and balance.

· Competitive salary and equity packages

· Health, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health resources

· An Oura Ring of your own and employee discounts for friends & family

· 20 days of paid time off, 13 paid holidays, and 8 days of flexible wellness time off

· Paid sick leave and parental leave

· A collaborative, mission-driven culture

We're looking for a Senior Content Designer to be the architect of Ziina's product voice — the person who shapes how we communicate at every touchpoint where language makes or breaks the experience.
You'll sit inside Product & Design, embedded from the moment ideas take shape, not brought in to polish copy at the end. As our first dedicated content hire, you'll set the foundation others build on: the voice, the principles, the terminology, the standards. UX writing is your primary craft, but this role demands range, moving across product copy, onboarding flows, and voice and tone guidelines, and leaning into brand and marketing writing when required.
This is about more than writing. It's about owning the full content lifecycle: from establishing terminology frameworks, to shipping copy that makes financial tasks feel effortless, to creating support responses that hold trust in high-stakes moments.

s.h: As a Senior Content Designer at Ziina, you will
s.t:
Own and write all in-product copy, including error states, empty states, onboarding flows, confirmation screens, transactional and lifecycle emails, push notifications, help center content, and support macros, extending to web copy and lifecycle communications when needed.
Partner closely with Product & Design teams, working in Figma to shape user flows, contribute to information architecture, and prototype content early in the design process.
Define and evolve Ziina’s voice and tone guidelines, including terminology frameworks, naming conventions, and content principles that scale across teams.
Establish and maintain a cohesive content system that ensures consistency and clarity across all product and communication surfaces.
Use A/B testing, usability insights, and conversion data to iterate on messaging and continuously improve content performance.
Support brand and marketing efforts by contributing to campaign messaging and ensuring consistency of voice across all channels.
Build and own AI-assisted content workflows, including prompt libraries and tooling that enable the team to scale high-quality content creation efficiently.

s.h: To succeed in this role, you likely
s.t:
Have 4+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally embedded within product or design teams at a fast-scaling company.
Have built and implemented content systems such as voice and tone guidelines, terminology frameworks, or component libraries that extend beyond your individual contributions.
Bring strong UX writing skills, with experience across a range of content types, including exposure to brand or marketing writing.
Work confidently in design tools like Figma, contributing directly to product flows, annotations, and design critiques.
Demonstrate strong product thinking and an understanding of information architecture, with the ability to identify structural and content gaps in user experiences.
Operate with high ownership and organization, managing competing priorities while delivering quality work on time.
Are comfortable using data and research to inform content decisions and improve user outcomes.
Are based in, or open to relocating to the UAE

You’ve been the first or early content hire and have built a content function or system from scratch.
You’ve worked on fintech, payments, or other high-trust products where clarity and tone are critical.
You’ve demonstrated measurable impact through content decisions, backed by experimentation or user insights.
You’ve developed scalable AI-assisted content workflows or tooling that improved team efficiency.
You bring a strong portfolio that showcases product copy in context, along with the thinking, systems, and data behind your decisions.
A portfolio is required. We want to see product copy in context, not just the final words, but the thinking behind them. Show us a content system or set of guidelines you've built, and at least one example where your writing decisions were shaped by user research or data.

We are looking for an experienced Content Designer to join a multidisciplinary User-Centred Design team delivering digital services for a major UK government organisation. You will work alongside other design professionals, with support from a permanent Senior Content Designer, to create accessible, clear and evidence-based content that meets user needs

As a Content Designer, you will take responsibility for developing and improving content throughout the service lifecycle. You will use research, data and testing to make informed content decisions, ensuring that services are accessible, easy to understand and written in plain English. You will work closely with user researchers, interaction designers, service designers, developers, product managers and other stakeholders within an Agile delivery environment.

Create accessible, user-centred content written in clear and concise plain English.
Follow established content processes, patterns and style guidelines.
Use qualitative and quantitative data to inform content decisions.
Develop different ways of presenting and explaining complex information.
Test content with users and refine it based on evidence and feedback.
Collaborate effectively with colleagues across a range of disciplines.
Advocate for user-centred and evidence-based content with stakeholders.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and multidisciplinary team activities.
Support the development of content layouts, prototypes and wireframes.
Essential experience
Substantial professional experience as a Content Designer.
Previous experience working within a UK government department or agency.
Strong knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive content design.
Demonstrable experience creating clear, accessible and plain English content.
Experience applying content patterns, standards and style guidelines.
Experience using user research and data to make content decisions.
Experience testing and iterating content.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Experience working within Agile delivery teams.
Eligibility to obtain Security Check clearance.
Desirable experience
Experience designing content for government or public sector digital services.
Familiarity with Government Digital Service principles and standards.
Experience using design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Mural, Lucid or Sketch.
Experience producing content layouts and wireframes.
Previous experience working as part of a wider User-Centred Design team.

As a Staff AI Content Designer on our team at HelloFresh, you’ll be instrumental in building the next generation of HelloFresh experiences — from how customers discover us, to how they personalize their plans, manage their subscriptions, and fall in love with cooking. You'll shape the language, logic, and voice of these experiences at a pivotal moment in how HelloFresh shows up for its customers.
This isn't a chatbot role. But it does require someone who understands how people converse with intelligent systems: how tone shifts in an exchange, how questions get asked and answered, how a response can feel natural or robotic depending on a single word choice.

Great content design in an AI-powered product environment demands both strategic systems thinking and genuine editorial craft. If you care deeply about the difference between good and great, and you can articulate why, this role is for you.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Design end-to-end consumer experiences: Own content strategy, narrative flow, and interaction logic across any part of our full customer journey ( discovery, personalization, shopping, subscription management, activation, and conversion funnels) . Maintain accountability for the full experience and hold a high bar for quality at every stage.
Leverage an AI-native workflow: Active usage of AI as a core part of your daily workflow includes synthesizing user insights, accelerating discovery, building rapid interactive prototypes ( using tools like Claude Code, Gemini, or Figma AI ), and closing the gap between design and implementation.
Lead content for AI-powered surfaces: Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to design adaptive, dynamic content experiences where copy responds intelligently to context, behavior, and customer signals rather than living on static screens.
Design for conversation and interaction: Bring an understanding of how customers converse with intelligent systems to bear on product decisions, shaping response patterns, interaction flows, and the rhythm of exchanges so they feel natural rather than mechanical.
Raise the quality bar: Serve as the authority in the room on copy precision, tone, and interaction clarity. Define what great looks like, provide substantive critique that raises the team's work, and build shared language for evaluating design and content decisions across the organization.
Drive experimentation and optimization: Collaborate on A/B testing, use data to inform design and content decisions, and build feedback loops that continuously improve the customer experience.
Build content systems that scale: Develop frameworks, modular content patterns, and governance models that help the broader team move faster without sacrificing quality or consistency.
Champion voice and standards: Serve as the authority on how HelloFresh speaks to customers, evolving our tone of voice guidelines to account for new interaction models including conversational and AI-generated content.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with UX Research, Product, Design, Engineering, and Data to ground content decisions in customer insight and ship experiences that convert and retain.
Support multi-brand execution: Adapt content for HelloFresh's family of brands, ensuring each speaks authentically to its distinct audience.

s.h: Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
s.t:
7+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, conversation design, or a closely related field
A portfolio that demonstrates not just strong output but a clear point of view. You can walk through your decisions, defend your choices, and show how your work raised the bar for the people around you
Experience designing for dynamic or personalized digital products; familiarity with AI-powered surfaces, recommendation systems, conversational flows, or adaptive content is a strong plus
An editorial sensibility that goes beyond execution. You know the difference between competent and exceptional, and you can put it into words
Proven ability to think in systems: zooming out to define the framework and zooming in to sweat the microcopy
Proven ability to influence product direction rather than just execute on it. You've shaped roadmaps, not just shipped copy
Comfort in experimentation-driven environments where you design for a hypothesis and learn from results
Experience in subscription, e-commerce, or growth-stage consumer products is a plus
Fluency in English; proficiency in Figma and AI tools like Claude or Gemini, and familiarity with agile ways of working

Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.
